Mission Update: More Opportunities for Big Rewards! 🚀💰

We've expanded the selection of missions—now there are even more to choose from! New high-reward contracts have been added, offering greater challenges and bigger payouts. Get ready to test your skills and enjoy an even more thrilling experience!

Adventure awaits! 🔥✨

notes.title: Update V02
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45487083/cb1637c5bc61f3d13f438755f55fd872cf46411c.jpg

🔹Hacking rewards adjusted!
The more complex the safe or hacking device, the greater the reward! Your hacking skills will now earn you even more valuable resources.

🔹 Drone minigame update!
To complete the mission, you now need to fly through 20 points. Get ready for a new challenge and refine your piloting skills!

🚀 Play, explore, and enjoy even more rewards!
